verdict.rationale: Fly's docs explicitly describe hardware-isolated Fly Machines that boot in under a second and 'run close to your users' with global scale-out (fly-io-docs-14), and its Sprites platform provisions per-request VMs with HTTPS URLs live immediately (fly-io-docs-7, fly-io-docs-8), backed by a global cloud positioning in its llms.txt (fly-io-probe-1). However, numerous hands-on community reports describe frequent regional outages, unreachable machines, and networking/deploy failures undermining reliable operation across regions (fly-io-comm-2, fly-io-comm-5, fly-io-comm-9, fly-io-comm-19), which is a real caveat on the promise of consistently running close to users. Missing for 10: independent latency/region-coverage benchmarks, and resolution of the reliability complaints that partially contradict smooth global operation.
